text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Splendid!! Casting aside all who stood 
before her, the Umamusume at the pinnacle 
of this clash of the century is... Grass 
Wonder! It is Grass Wonder!!
(WAAAAAAH...!!)

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Trainer! I...!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Nnnngh, yes!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Fufu, oh dear. I really should have 
studied more Japanese.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
“Still, no, maybe that's not it. Even in 
English, I can't think of anything at 
all.”

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...There are no words to describe this 
exhilaration right now!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...I lost.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Suzuka-senpai...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much for this valuable 
opportunity.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: No, the pleasure's all mine.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Still, maybe it's still not enough.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"It can't end with just this one chance. I 
want to run with you again."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
When that time comes... I won't give up 
the lead. Not ever.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...I will etch it firmly into my heart.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ghaaaaaaaaah--!! I'm mad, so mad, so MAD, 
I TELL YOOOU!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Pouring in all my strength! Going full 
throttle! Putting my whole heart and soul 
into it, and even still...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
You got in front of me?!! 
Graaaaaaahhhhhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...El's ears are stinging a little from 
hearing that.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El's heart is aching here, so the least 
you can do is endure the earful, deeeesu!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Even if you say so...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Either way!! I ab-so-lute-ly won't let it 
end like this.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El will be leaving Japan soon to take on 
the world. And then train nonstop! Like 
crazy!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
When I make my phoenix-like comeback, that 
will be the moment you taste defeat!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Now, now... Fufu.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: —However.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad I got to etch this into my 
heart before taking flight into the world!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"I was supposed to enchant the world— yet 
here I am, completely enchanted by your 
running."

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Wh... What... What in the world was that I 
just witnessed...!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: ...'Grass Wonder'

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
It's Grass Wonder! Grass Wonder!! An 
Umamusume defining an era, etching her 
name in history!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder...!! I'm gonna write the best 
article about her yet!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Whoooooooa!!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my. What an incredibly passionate 
reporter, aren't you? Fufu, so cuuute.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...Speee-chan.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yikes!? I'm sorry, what was that 
again...!?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, I haven't said anything yet♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
“Judging by that reaction, though, it 
looks like you reeeally couldn't take your 
eyes off me.”

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Um... excuse me...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka-san, El-chan, Grass-chan... They're 
all frighteningly good.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Everyone's... so far away. And I—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe, and away they go.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...You're quite greedy yourself, 
Maruzensky.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder is up first, and next is 
Special Week, huh.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh my, don't make it sound so bad♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it only natural to want these sweet, 
lovely girls to grow up big and strong?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Besides, calling me "greedy" of all 
things... ...Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Including you, all of us are like that, 
right!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Regarding the next race we should 
aim for...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I will never show such a half-hearted 
performance as last year. I will show you 
the culmination of this entire year with 
everything I have.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
So please, by all means, send me to the 
'Arima Kinen'!
choice_data_list: Let's train hard and take it on!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The end of the road is still far away. I 
will never stop moving forward!
